QuestInfo.name: A Hero's Deeds
QuestInfo.0: Maha might know something about the hero's deeds. Listen to what Maha has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Maha tells you that you need to find a hero. Upon hearing that, you remember the name #bFreud#k, who apparently left the Seal Stone in Orbis.
QuestInfo.2: Freud was your friend and one of the five heroes who sealed the Black Mage. Ask Tru if he knows anything about Freud's whereabouts.

default.0: You finally remembered your friend's name. What are you still doing here then?
